backtest_protocol: docs/backtesting.md artifact persistence path; no strategy replay mutation
change_summary: Backtest JSON artifacts are now saved through a same-directory temporary file followed by atomic replace, reducing the risk of malformed same-date artifacts when outputs are overwritten.

gate1.baseline_artifact_issue: data/backtests/backtest_results_20260522.json parsed one JSON object but had extra trailing data after byte 2007649 of 2010969.

gate4.reason: Measurement repair only; no entry, exit, ranking, sizing, filter, risk budget, LLM, or order behavior changed.

hypothesis: Backtest result artifacts must be atomically written so experiment conclusions are reproducible and not vulnerable to partially overwritten JSON files.
known_risks: This does not repair already-malformed historical artifacts.
Atomic replace protects complete-file visibility but does not serialize concurrent writers choosing the same output filename.
next_evidence_needed: Future canonical backtests should overwrite same-date result artifacts through the atomic write helper and remain parseable.

verification.atomic_helper_probe: passed: parsed atomically written JSON and found no leftover .tmp files

why_not_other_changes: After exp-20260523-015 failed Gate 4, only the artifact-integrity defect was repaired; no new alpha or production order behavior was changed.
